Thank you, Miranda.

Good morning, everyone. It's a pleasure to meet you all in person.

I'm Boyd, an industrial designer.

Today, I'll walk you through the design ideas behind three strollers and one car seat. Some of you may have already seen the samples, so I'll focus on the key features, demonstrate how they work, and explain the thinking behind the designs.

I'm looking forward to sharing our ideas with you and hearing your feedback.

With that, let's get started with our first stroller.
